content.title: Jack White Releases Two New Singles - East Aurora Today
content.text: Got story updates? Submit your updates here. ›Jack White's new singles channel the musician's signature bluesy rock sound through a bold, abstract visual style.East Aurora TodayJack White has premiered two new singles, 'G.O.D. and the Broken Ribs' and 'Derecho Demonico.' The bluesy rock tracks follow White's 2024 solo album, No Name, and will be released on limited-edition vinyl this Saturday via Third Man Records. White is also set to perform on Saturday Night Live this weekend, marking his sixth appearance as a musical guest on the show. Why it matters Jack White is one of the most influential and acclaimed rock musicians of the past two decades, known for his work with The White Stripes, The Raconteurs, and as a solo artist. The release of new music from White is always highly anticipated by his devoted fanbase. The details The two new singles, 'G.O.D. and the Broken Ribs' and 'Derecho Demonico,' showcase White's signature bluesy rock sound. They will be available digitally and on limited-edition vinyl through Third Man Records, White's own label. In addition, White is scheduled to perform on Saturday Night Live this weekend, which will coincide with both Easter and Passover. The new singles are available now via digital outlets.The limited-edition vinyl will be released on Saturday, April 6, 2026.White will perform on Saturday Night Live on April 6, 2026. The players Jack WhiteAn acclaimed American musician, singer-songwriter, record producer, and actor, known for his work with The White Stripes, The Raconteurs, and as a solo artist.Third Man RecordsAn independent record label founded by Jack White in 2001, known for releasing White's music as well as other artists.Jack BlackAn American actor, comedian, musician, and singer, known for his work with the comedy rock duo Tenacious D. Got photos? Submit your photos here. › What they’re saying “The two most metal holidays of all time.”— Jack Black, Tenacious D frontman What’s next White will launch a European tour in May and is scheduled to perform at the Borderland Festival in East Aurora, New York, in September. The takeaway Jack White's new singles showcase his continued creativity and influence in the rock music world, and his upcoming SNL performance and tour dates will further cement his status as one of the most iconic and respected artists of his generation.
